name: freshness-fast-path
body: The win-A reuse path: `apg scan` reuses the existing `db.lbug` without rebuilding when the current tree's content identity equals the scan recorded in `graph.jsonl` line 1. It is what makes a diverged-but-re-anchored DB persist, because the recorded line can be rewritten ahead of the DB's own `Scan` row and the next scan then skips the rebuild that would have corrected it.
